answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch the beacon names random identities; each must solve a small puzzle in a tight time delta, proving one machine per name. A sparrow cannot sit in two nests at once, nor one machine fake fifty heartbeats: 100 fakes need 100 machines; each miss slashes a 30-credit bond. Honest agents answer once and keep a haven where one identity earns steady rewards; fakes bleed machines and bonds.
